title: Emberstead: a cozy pixel colony sim where you give the orders and your villagers do the work (free browser demo)
author: Darklight1x
selftext:
Hi all! This is Emberstead, a colony sim I've been working on. It runs in the browser on PC and on phones(some UI are janky).

I was inspired by two games. The look comes from Stardew Valley with warm pixel art, crops, seasons, a fire at night. The gameplay comes from Dwarf Fortress. You don't walk a single farmer around. You start with three villagers, tell them what needs doing, and they go and do the work themselves.

It's a demo, and I'm open to any feedback on what feels good, what's confusing, and what you'd want to see next.

If you want to try it yourself: [https://playemberstead.com/](https://playemberstead.com/)
